label: positive

blockers.detail: nghttp2_session_server_new(&session, callbacks, nullptr): no nghttp2_option, so the built-in receive extension NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE is never enabled and every PRIORITY_UPDATE frame (type 0x10) is ignored at session.c:6354
the harness submits only SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS=100; without SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 the frame is ignored again at session.c:6383 even when the extension is enabled

evidence: M (PR #1729, RFC 9218 PRIORITY_UPDATE) adds the frame type 0x10 with its own payload format (nghttp2_frame_unpack_priority_update_payload) and makes it processable only behind nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type(NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE) plus a local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1; fuzz/fuzz_target.cc is unchanged (last changed 2017)

partial fixes: enabling only the extension option leaves the frame dropped at session.c:6383 (unpack/processing lines stay 0); sending only the setting leaves it dropped at session.c:6354 (all frame-path lines stay 0)

with the counterfactual fix the budgeted fuzzing quickly reaches a library assertion in nghttp2_session_mem_recv (nghttp2_session.c:6845, `iframe->state == NGHTTP2_IB_IGN_ALL`) on the newly reachable path - code the original harness could never exercise
rationale_zh: 本次合并（PR #1729）实现 RFC 9218 的 PRIORITY_UPDATE 帧：新增帧类型 0x10 及其载荷格式（input_format：服务器端新接受的一种帧格式），但只有在两项配置同时满足时才处理——会话选项 nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type(NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE) 打开内建扩展，且本端 SETTINGS 中声明 NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1（configuration）。harness 自 2017 年起用 nghttp2_session_server_new(..., nullptr) 建会话、只提交 MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS 一项设置，因此任何 0x10 帧都在 session.c:6354 被忽略；只开选项不发设置又会在 6383 行被忽略。新帧格式的解包、处理与优先级更新代码覆盖恒为 0，harness 照常运行。两个维度缺一不可：新格式本身需要新配置才可达，正是分布设计中“新格式分支需要新 flag 才可达”的隐式 mix。反事实修复 Δh（约 16 行，只改 harness）打开选项并按输入奇偶决定是否发送该设置；打开后定额 fuzz 很快在新路径上触发库内断言（session.c:6845），说明这段从未被 fuzz 过的代码确有问题。M^1 不存在该帧类型，缺口由本次引入。
rationale_en: This merge (PR #1729) implements the RFC 9218 PRIORITY_UPDATE frame: a new frame type 0x10 with its own payload format (input_format: a frame format the server now accepts), processed only when two configuration conditions hold - the session option nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type(NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE) enables the built-in extension and the local SETTINGS announce NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 (configuration). Since 2017 the harness creates the session with nghttp2_session_server_new(..., nullptr) and submits only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS, so every 0x10 frame is ignored at session.c:6354; enabling only the option still drops it at line 6383. The unpacking, processing and priority-update code of the new frame format keeps zero coverage while the harness runs normally. Both dimensions are needed: the new format is reachable only through the new configuration - the 'new format branch that needs a new flag' silent mix of the distribution design. The counterfactual fix (about 16 lines, harness only) enables the option and sends the setting for odd-sized inputs; with it, budgeted fuzzing soon trips a library assertion on the new path (session.c:6845), showing that this never-fuzzed code does have problems. The frame type does not exist at M^1, so the gap is introduced by this change.
